items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had to play with left hand because Buck and Bubbles told us we had to.

ctx.x: In the playing. I think they knew more music than the New York—the New York people didn’t play with any left hand. We had to play with left hand because Buck and Bubbles told us we had to.
Is that why, wait a minute…
